Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2D character-part atlas for Brasswake, an elevated top-down fantasy RPG.
Image 1 is the accepted male average BODY PROFILE; match its anatomy, silhouette, body fat/muscle mass, adult proportions and hand-painted finish. Image 2 is the game scenery style reference. Image 3 is the approved modular leather sample: follow its EXACT detached-parts structure and column headings, changing body fit and costume as requested.
NEW OUTFIT: worn undyed ivory linen short belted tunic, rolled short sleeves with bare forearms, patched dark brown trousers and brown ankle boots; fine cloth weave, sewn hems, small worn leather belt. Fit this specific male average physique. Do not make a heavy body thin or muscular body frail. No head or face anywhere.
Layout: FIVE separate columns, FIVE isolated horizontal rows. Consistent headings by column: SOUTH facing toward viewer, SOUTHEAST, EAST profile, NORTHEAST, NORTH away. Elevated orthographic camera, about 35 degrees down, as in body reference. Every part is vertical and neutral; rounded overlapping joint ends make a painted skeletal sprite.
ROW 1: only HEADLESS ARMLESS torso, shoulder line to pelvis and short upper-thigh hem (no legs).
ROW 2: ONE isolated upper arm from shoulder to elbow, no torso or hand.
ROW 3: ONE isolated forearm from elbow THROUGH relaxed closed hand, no upper arm.
ROW 4: ONE isolated thigh from hip to knee, no shin.
ROW 5: ONE isolated shin from knee THROUGH boot sole, no thigh.

All cells detached, centered, generous transparent margins; no pieces touch or cross cell boundaries. Each row the same kind of part, all five headings in order. Preserve practical anatomical proportions. Warm subdued painted pigment, fine material imperfections, lightly drawn contour, clear controlled highlights. No smooth CGI, plastic or glossy skin. No weapons, accessories, hats, captions, grid lines, drop shadows or ground. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background. Wide 1536x1024 production sheet.
